text:
rachel: starting rollout v2026.4 -> canary (us-east1). deploy-bot kicked at 09:07ET. change window open 30m. release_notes: quantization profile updates + kv cache heuristics.
deploy-bot: Deploy job ignite-canary-3300001111 started. image: redwood/inference:2026.4-canary. pods 4 -> 4. routing 5% by default. running smoke suite (short prompts + embeds).
dave: initial synth 25 requests: 25/25 returned but tail latency p99 jumped from 450ms -> 1.6s on generate route. error rate zero. looks like long tail, maybe batching/quanta effect.
sre_lee: health probes from LB show occasional 502s (backend reset) matching p99 spikes. i'll pull pod logs.
pm_nina: if this is quantization-induced tail, options: 1) pin canary to v2026.3 (rollback) 2) keep canary but cap concurrency & enable small-quantized-prefill to warm kernels 3) accept and monitor. thoughts?
dave: option 2 seems lower-risk. we can reduce max_concurrency to 8 and run the "quant-prefill" job that walks a few sample prefills through the new kernels (~45s). will trigger now.
sre_lee: setting LB drain to 0% and applying concurrency cap. deploying a short-lived job to pre-run kernels.
deploy-bot: traffic reduced to 2%. concurrency cap applied. quant-prefill job started (job/qprefill-3300001111). logs streaming.
dave: prefill done. rerunning synth (25 reqs). results: p99 now ~520ms, p95 ~210ms. no 502s.
pm_nina: nice. let's hold at 5% for 15m and ramp if stable. set rollback timer 15m. if p99 > 1s or 502s > 1% during window, rollback.
sre_lee: adding alert rule to watch canary 502s and p99, will page on thresholds. also adding note to release notes: "canary warmup required for quantized kernels; automated prefill added."
deploy-bot: Canary status: healthy. scheduled ramp +15m.
rachel: documenting handoff: include graphs for p99 before/after and the prefill job logs in postdeploy verification doc. thanks team.
pm_nina: follow-up: create PR to default-enable small prefill for quantized model variants during canary rollout. filing ticket INF-7721.
sre_lee: acknowledged. I'll watch alerting window. roll timer set to +15m.
deploy-bot: rolling monitor: last_check OK. thread closing after handoff.
